components.name: Navigation
components.description: Brass current item and top indicator.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;background:var(--ink,#191f1d);border-top:1px solid var(--line,#414c40);height:68px}.ds-nav button{position:relative;font:14px Geist,sans-serif;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#b5bcac);padding:10px 15px;cursor:pointer}.ds-nav button[aria-current]{color:var(--brass,#d0ae76);background:#242c24}.ds-nav button[aria-current]:after{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:calc(50% - 15px);width:30px;height:2px;background:var(--brass,#d0ae76)}.ds-nav button:hover{background:#344034}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--brass,#d0ae76);outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview: An ink-and-parchment atlas with restrained brass actions and a dynasty crest. The implemented interface uses compact Turkish controls, flat divided rows and a dominant map. User direction is code-first; image generation was cancelled.
keyCharacteristics: Dark tonal surfaces and parchment text.
Brass selected states and primary actions.
Compact management rows around a canvas atlas.
dos: Do reuse the implemented semantic colors and visible focus treatment.
Do pair territorial colors with labels.
Do respect reduced motion and mobile safe areas.
donts: Don't replace the atlas identity with neon, glass effects or ornamental fantasy frames.
Don't describe untested mobile layouts as visually verified.
